label: late copy-phase steps, strongest in short (L<=4) sequences and on fed-back tokens 2/o/h/m/p/i
explanation: Active almost only in the copy phase (99.9% of mass). It never fires on the delimiter step or at recall_idx 0, and almost never in the original phase (rare weak hits at t=1). Within the copy phase it concentrates on the last three outputs (to_go<=2, 93% of mass). Rate and magnitude are highest for short sequences: L=3 copy steps fire 33% of the time and L=4 16%, versus about 3-5% for L>=5. The largest activations (up to max) are at recall_idx 1 of L=3 sequences when the fed-back input is 2, o or h. Magnitude also depends on the token: fed-back inputs 2, o, h, m, p, i fire at 2-4x the base rate, and output c is also elevated. Precision is incomplete: most late copy steps in long sequences with other tokens stay silent.
